documentation.name: PROJECT.md
documentation.summary: Project charter for the PMS frontend: defines the goal of completing a modular React/TypeScript property management system for homestay/resort operators, its tech stack (React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Flowbite, Axios), constraints around existing microservice APIs, and lessons learned from prior work on invoices, reservations, and orders.

documentation.name: REQUIREMENTS.md
documentation.summary: Functional and non-functional requirements for the PMS improvement effort, covering order-invoice integration, tour management persistence, dynamic room maps, advanced filtering, user stories, and success criteria for verifying completion.

documentation.name: ROADMAP.md
documentation.summary: Phased delivery roadmap for the PMS improvement project, tracking completed phases (foundation/refactoring, config caching, feature persistence, dynamic room integration, room/invoice map optimization), the current phase (advanced UX & optimization), and future phases like a mobile companion app and reporting dashboard.

documentation.name: STATE.md
documentation.summary: Living project-state log tracking the current roadmap phase, recent completed quick tasks and phase work (e.g. rate-plan menu fix, TLS config, room API refactor, ID-based room mapping), and pending tasks for the PMS project.

documentation.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
documentation.summary: Describes the PMS-TS frontend architecture: functional React components with hooks, a Service-Repository split between UI (src/Components/) and data access (src/db/), lifted state in App.tsx with no global state library, React Router v6 routing with RBAC-driven menu filtering, OIDC/JWT-based authentication, and a Tailwind CSS + Flowbite UI layer.

documentation.name: CONCERNS.md
documentation.summary: Catalogs technical debt, security risks, performance bottlenecks, and missing features in pms-ts, including overuse of `any`, monolithic components like InvoiceEditor.tsx and App.tsx, hardcoded API keys and business data, fragile auth logic, and the complete absence of automated tests.

documentation.name: CONVENTIONS.md
documentation.summary: Defines pms-ts coding standards: PascalCase for components and services, mixed snake_case/kebab-case for db modules, Prettier with the Tailwind plugin, ESLint react-app rules, and architectural rules for component structure, data access via db/apis.ts, multi-tenancy via tenantId, and env-based configuration.

documentation.name: INTEGRATIONS.md
documentation.summary: Lists external integrations used by pms-ts, including OIDC/Keycloak authentication with RBAC, a suite of Phuc Sinh Assistant backend microservices (expense, inventory, invoice, profit, reservation, order, supplier, tour), Google Gemini AI for data extraction, MinIO object storage, and Firebase/GCS cloud integrations.

documentation.name: STACK.md
documentation.summary: Summarizes the pms-ts technology stack: TypeScript on React 18 with React Router v6, Tailwind CSS with Flowbite components, Axios for HTTP, Moment.js for dates, Google Generative AI, MinIO SDK, and a Webpack/react-app-rewired/Babel/PostCSS/Prettier build toolchain.

documentation.name: STRUCTURE.md
documentation.summary: Maps the pms-ts directory layout, explaining the roles of src/Components/ (Manager, Editor, and Map components), src/db/ (API repositories), src/Service/ (utilities like FileMinio.ts and Utils.ts), the App.tsx/index.tsx entry points, public/ static assets, and top-level config files.

documentation.name: TESTING.md
documentation.summary: Defines the intended testing strategy for pms-ts using Jest and React Testing Library, covering unit tests for src/Service/ and src/db/, component tests for src/Components/, the absence of E2E tooling, mocking guidance for API calls, and coverage goals for critical domain logic.

documentation.name: 01-RESEARCH.md
documentation.summary: Research notes analyzing the redundant `roomIcons` mapping in src/db/room.tsx, tracing its usage to InvoiceEditor.tsx, and recommending removal in favor of a single standardized icon since other room components (RoomManager, ReservationMap, InvoiceMap) already avoid it.

documentation.name: 04-PLAN.md
documentation.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 4 (Dynamic Room Integration refinement), detailing tasks to remove the static roomIcons mapping, standardize the room selection UI in InvoiceEditor with a single icon, finalize elimination of static room data, and verify the build with tsc.

documentation.name: 04-SUMMARY.md
documentation.summary: Completion summary for Phase 4, confirming removal of the roomIcons mapping and src/db/staticdata.ts, standardization of InvoiceEditor's room selection icons, and full transition to dynamic backend-driven room data via the listRoom API.

documentation.name: configure-tls-port.md
documentation.summary: Quick-fix note describing how to enable HTTPS on port 3001 for local development by adding HTTPS=true to .env.development alongside the existing PORT=3001 setting.

documentation.name: fix-menu-path-error.md
documentation.summary: Quick-fix note for a startup TypeError in App.tsx caused by a mismatch between the 'rate-plan' key in menuOrder and the 'ratePlan' key in the menus object, resolved by aligning the keys and adding a safety filter in filterMenus.

documentation.name: fix-rate-plan-visibility.md
documentation.summary: Quick-fix note explaining why the Rate Plan menu item was hidden due to a camelCase/kebab-case mismatch between the 'ratePlan' menu key and the backend-provided 'rate-plan' authority string, fixed by standardizing on 'rate-plan' throughout App.tsx.

documentation.name: fix-room-preselection.md
documentation.summary: Quick-fix note for InvoiceEditor's chooseRoom function, which failed to pre-select rooms in the modal because it matched invoice.rooms values against room.name instead of the correct room.internalName field.

documentation.name: rename-room-to-ts.md
documentation.summary: Quick-fix note documenting the rename of src/db/room.tsx to src/db/room.ts, since the file no longer contains JSX and a .ts extension better reflects its pure TypeScript content.

documentation.name: copilot-instructions.md
documentation.summary: GitHub Copilot custom instructions directing the AI assistant to invoke Azure best-practice tooling when generating Azure-related code or running Azure commands.

documentation.name: 01-PLAN.md
documentation.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 1 covering PaymentMethod type refactoring into configs.ts, dynamic AppConfig distribution to InvoiceEditor, API factory consolidation in apis.ts, and verification of room/map data.

documentation.name: 01-RESEARCH.md
documentation.summary: Research notes for Phase 1 documenting the standard stack (Axios, flowbite-react), the configuration-provider and API-factory architecture patterns, and pitfalls to avoid when refactoring payment methods and config loading.

documentation.name: 02-PLAN.md
documentation.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 2 adding a cache-first localStorage strategy and a 3-attempt async retry mechanism to appConfigs, plus App.tsx loading/error state handling for offline resilience.

documentation.name: 02-RESEARCH.md
documentation.summary: Research notes for Phase 2 detailing the cache-first-with-background-refresh pattern, idempotent background refresh, and asynchronous retry mechanism for loading app.json configuration, with sample retry-wrapper and appConfigs code.

documentation.name: 04-CONTEXT.md
documentation.summary: Context notes for Phase 4 defining the scope of dynamic room integration, targeting room.ts and invoice.ts to remove hardcoded room identifiers, with UX enhancements deferred to Phase 5.

documentation.name: 06-PLAN.md
documentation.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 6 refactoring RoomManager and InvoiceMap to use room IDs for consistent mapping, optimizing component lifecycle, and synchronizing UI between the two map views.

documentation.name: 06-RESEARCH.md
documentation.summary: Research notes for Phase 6 analyzing data inconsistencies between RoomManager and InvoiceMap (name-based vs ID-based mapping) and proposing an ID-based, static-grid rendering approach.

document:.planning/codebase/CONVENTIONS..summary: Defines pms-ts coding standards: PascalCase for components and services, mixed snake_case/kebab-case for db modules, Prettier with the Tailwind plugin, ESLint react-app rules, and architectural rules for component structure, data access via db/apis.ts, multi-tenancy via tenantId, and env-based configuration.

document:.planning/codebase/INTEGRATIONS.name: INTEGRATIONS.md
document:.planning/codebase/INTEGRATIONS.summary: Lists external integrations used by pms-ts, including OIDC/Keycloak authentication with RBAC, a suite of Phuc Sinh Assistant backend microservices (expense, inventory, invoice, profit, reservation, order, supplier, tour), Google Gemini AI for data extraction, MinIO object storage, and Firebase/GCS cloud integrations.

document:.planning/codebase/STACK.md.name: STACK.md
document:.planning/codebase/STACK.md.summary: Summarizes the pms-ts technology stack: TypeScript on React 18 with React Router v6, Tailwind CSS with Flowbite components, Axios for HTTP, Moment.js for dates, Google Generative AI, MinIO SDK, and a Webpack/react-app-rewired/Babel/PostCSS/Prettier build toolchain.

document:.planning/codebase/STRUCTURE.md.name: STRUCTURE.md
document:.planning/codebase/STRUCTURE.md.summary: Maps the pms-ts directory layout, explaining the roles of src/Components/ (Manager, Editor, and Map components), src/db/ (API repositories), src/Service/ (utilities like FileMinio.ts and Utils.ts), the App.tsx/index.tsx entry points, public/ static assets, and top-level config files.

document:.planning/codebase/TESTING.md.name: TESTING.md
document:.planning/codebase/TESTING.md.summary: Defines the intended testing strategy for pms-ts using Jest and React Testing Library, covering unit tests for src/Service/ and src/db/, component tests for src/Components/, the absence of E2E tooling, mocking guidance for API calls, and coverage goals for critical domain logic.

document:.planning/phases/04-dynamic-roo.name: 01-RESEARCH.md
document:.planning/phases/04-dynamic-roo.summary: Research notes analyzing the redundant `roomIcons` mapping in src/db/room.tsx, tracing its usage to InvoiceEditor.tsx, and recommending removal in favor of a single standardized icon since other room components (RoomManager, ReservationMap, InvoiceMap) already avoid it.

document:.planning/phases/04-dynamic-roo.name: 04-PLAN.md
document:.planning/phases/04-dynamic-roo.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 4 (Dynamic Room Integration refinement), detailing tasks to remove the static roomIcons mapping, standardize the room selection UI in InvoiceEditor with a single icon, finalize elimination of static room data, and verify the build with tsc.

document:.planning/phases/04-dynamic-roo.name: 04-SUMMARY.md
document:.planning/phases/04-dynamic-roo.summary: Completion summary for Phase 4, confirming removal of the roomIcons mapping and src/db/staticdata.ts, standardization of InvoiceEditor's room selection icons, and full transition to dynamic backend-driven room data via the listRoom API.

document:.planning/quick/configure-tls-p.name: configure-tls-port.md
document:.planning/quick/configure-tls-p.summary: Quick-fix note describing how to enable HTTPS on port 3001 for local development by adding HTTPS=true to .env.development alongside the existing PORT=3001 setting.

document:.planning/quick/fix-menu-path-e.name: fix-menu-path-error.md
document:.planning/quick/fix-menu-path-e.summary: Quick-fix note for a startup TypeError in App.tsx caused by a mismatch between the 'rate-plan' key in menuOrder and the 'ratePlan' key in the menus object, resolved by aligning the keys and adding a safety filter in filterMenus.

document:.planning/quick/fix-rate-plan-v.name: fix-rate-plan-visibility.md
document:.planning/quick/fix-rate-plan-v.summary: Quick-fix note explaining why the Rate Plan menu item was hidden due to a camelCase/kebab-case mismatch between the 'ratePlan' menu key and the backend-provided 'rate-plan' authority string, fixed by standardizing on 'rate-plan' throughout App.tsx.

document:.planning/quick/fix-room-presel.name: fix-room-preselection.md
document:.planning/quick/fix-room-presel.summary: Quick-fix note for InvoiceEditor's chooseRoom function, which failed to pre-select rooms in the modal because it matched invoice.rooms values against room.name instead of the correct room.internalName field.

document:.planning/quick/rename-room-to-.name: rename-room-to-ts.md
document:.planning/quick/rename-room-to-.summary: Quick-fix note documenting the rename of src/db/room.tsx to src/db/room.ts, since the file no longer contains JSX and a .ts extension better reflects its pure TypeScript content.

config:.bg-shell/manifest.json.name: manifest.json

document:.planning/phases/01-foundation-.name: 01-PLAN.md
document:.planning/phases/01-foundation-.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 1 covering PaymentMethod type refactoring into configs.ts, dynamic AppConfig distribution to InvoiceEditor, API factory consolidation in apis.ts, and verification of room/map data.

document:.planning/phases/01-foundation-.name: 01-RESEARCH.md
document:.planning/phases/01-foundation-.summary: Research notes for Phase 1 documenting the standard stack (Axios, flowbite-react), the configuration-provider and API-factory architecture patterns, and pitfalls to avoid when refactoring payment methods and config loading.

document:.planning/phases/02-configurati.name: 02-PLAN.md
document:.planning/phases/02-configurati.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 2 adding a cache-first localStorage strategy and a 3-attempt async retry mechanism to appConfigs, plus App.tsx loading/error state handling for offline resilience.

document:.planning/phases/02-configurati.name: 02-RESEARCH.md
document:.planning/phases/02-configurati.summary: Research notes for Phase 2 detailing the cache-first-with-background-refresh pattern, idempotent background refresh, and asynchronous retry mechanism for loading app.json configuration, with sample retry-wrapper and appConfigs code.

document:.planning/phases/04-CONTEXT.md.name: 04-CONTEXT.md
document:.planning/phases/04-CONTEXT.md.summary: Context notes for Phase 4 defining the scope of dynamic room integration, targeting room.ts and invoice.ts to remove hardcoded room identifiers, with UX enhancements deferred to Phase 5.

document:.planning/phases/06-room-invoic.name: 06-PLAN.md
document:.planning/phases/06-room-invoic.summary: Implementation plan for Phase 6 refactoring RoomManager and InvoiceMap to use room IDs for consistent mapping, optimizing component lifecycle, and synchronizing UI between the two map views.

document:.planning/phases/06-room-invoic.name: 06-RESEARCH.md
document:.planning/phases/06-room-invoic.summary: Research notes for Phase 6 analyzing data inconsistencies between RoomManager and InvoiceMap (name-based vs ID-based mapping) and proposing an ID-based, static-grid rendering approach.

document:.planning/todos/01-bugs/fix-the.name: fix-the-compile-error.md
